required_secrets.note: The combined `github` envelope (github_core >= v0.5.0, req-github-core-app-auth): an `app` block — a READ-ONLY GitHub App installed on the observed account (`data.owner`), minted with github_core's create-github-app skill — and/or a `pat` block — a fine-grained READ-ONLY PAT whose resource owner is the observed account, minted by hand in GitHub's UI — routed per collection source, never by preference order. Legacy `github_pat` / `github_app` envelopes still fold on read. Permissions are the union of what github_core's collection manifest declares per source; its App-permission ledger (github_app_permissions.json) is the authoritative list, and packages stay unobservable under an App credential until GitHub enables that surface for Apps.

description: git-serious — the product composition (plan/product-map.md: a product is an umbrella plugin whose boot record IS what it is). Stands the product up against one GitHub account: installs the substrate (identity_core), the GitHub vocabulary + collector (github_core, account-scoped per req-github-core-org-scope), the admin pages (administrivia), and git-serious itself (the landing page); seeds the GRIFT; then fires the github_core collector to pull the account's CI/CD system onto the grid. DEV-PHASE record: github_core, identity_core and administrivia pin immutable tags; git_serious's self-reference is still a branch while the product lands, and the first tagged release pins it per req-boot-bootstrap-stage0-3. Install order lists substrate before consumers so git-sourced dependency resolution finds them installed.

steps.note: ONLY the workflow page: every workflow node on git-serious's graphs and the status wall's History column open /github_core/workflow, and installing github_core does not populate it (git-serious-tap#75). The repo-landing bundle stays out — it seeds /samsite/repo and git-serious owns the repository page. Before git_serious, so a later edge into this page finds it.
git-serious landing page: the account's CI/CD system as a graph.

Pulls the configured scope onto the grid: the account's repositories, workflows, runs, jobs, runners, apps. Fires against whatever github_pat envelope is placed — until the account-scoped PAT lands this is the shared repos-only credential, which makes the first boot an end-to-end smoke test of the collector path rather than the org picture.
